Four warm palettes for the visual-report house style

Each column renders the same sample in one palette: answer box, section header, table with a highlighted cell, inline code, code panel, DAG nodes, chart series and the two semantic callouts. Fonts follow variant B. Paper starts from B's background #fbfbf9, warmed per palette. Every text pair passes WCAG AA (4.5:1) and every graphic pair 3:1; the ratio table sits under each column.
